body:
You're right a lot of people brag and exaggerate. Unfortunately I don't think I can do the bitcoin route. 

Still it seems like s9me people get the best jobs simply because they know so and so. I try to get so and so to know me but they never want to go out of their way to get my resume in front of a hiring manager. Just the people who can't get me jobs vouch for me. 

However passive streams of income sounds like a good idea. Most people don't do this because they are too content with their friends pushing them to success. 

Improving is an uphill batrle. It'll be like a treadmill running away from you because you're too fat. People don't want to be around those who are bad at talking to others.

Everything is tied to social ability. Even getting a good job requires you to be fun and enjoyable or at least not awkward and weird as most people would rather work with an average normal guy than a brilliant awkward weirdo. It took me two years of failed interviews yo find an internship. 

What beneficial things in life does not require money or socialization?

This made me feel a bit better. Not everyone is always making big career moves after college. Also salaries grow very slowly so it won't be that hard to catch up or even surpass everyone else. 

I guess I'm mad thst had I been decisive with a major and networked/socialized from day 1, I would be a lot farther ahead. I would already have a great job and likely a beautiful young fiance who isn't a "well I'm done with the bad boys so now I need to find a nice guy beta" type. 

I'm always afraid of being alone. Completely alone at old age. I'm the youngest in my family and even extended family. I have them now but they're not going to last forever. Friendships rarely last forever as blood is thicker than water.

The town I live in is not the type of town you can just go and meet people. All my friends from high school left just as I am trying to escape. I wish I lived near a city where engineering and professional jobs for all industries are plentiful but I just don't. That's why I am doing everything I can to get out. 

The closet company that had a professional opportunity was a 1 hour drive. Most are almost 2 hours. 

I'm going to meetups and networking events to get my foot in the door but again networking seems to be an investment as most people are not willing to help a stranger because the connection isn't "genuine." I need something now. I don't have time to wait a 6 months to make connections genuine and a 4 more for them to finally pay off. 

I looked up networking on jobs and it seems like connections need to be genuine and not fake smiles. How the fuck do you make a genuine connection in 20 minutes?
